name: Picture in Picture
description: Draws the second input over the first, scaled and positioned, honouring its alpha.

inputs.name: top
inputs.description: Video drawn on top (alpha is honoured)

params.name: x
params.description: Left edge of the overlay, 0..1 of the frame width

params.name: y
params.description: Top edge of the overlay, 0..1 of the frame height

params.name: scale
params.description: Overlay width relative to the frame width
